source: A Sonata from a lost age that belongs to the uncrowned king. Some voices seem to be forgotten, but their awakening often requires but a short segment of a familiar melody.
target: Uma Sonata de uma era perdida que pertence ao rei sem coroa. Algumas vozes parecem ser esquecidas, mas seu despertar muitas vezes requer apenas um curto segmento de uma melodia familiar.

source: A high-spirited and intense Sonata that belongs to the warriors who can conquer the battlefield. The burning flame is the beat of the march, the triumphant steps on the flame with burning convictions.
target: Uma Sonata animada e intensa que pertence aos guerreiros que podem conquistar o campo de batalha. A chama ardente é o ritmo da marcha, os passos triunfantes sobre a chama com convicções ardentes.

source: A noisy, wild but vibrant Sonata that belongs to the ever-flourishing lives. Those who profess to be extraordinary often show little patience to listen to the call of the wilder, until that voice is close to their ear.
target: Uma Sonata barulhenta, selvagem, mas vibrante que pertence às vidas sempre florescentes. Aqueles que se dizem extraordinários muitas vezes mostram pouca paciência para ouvir o chamado da natureza, até que essa voz esteja próxima ao seu ouvido.

source: A poignant, sorrow-evoking Sonata that belongs to the lonely bereaved. When the calling is never answered, even the wings that once soared the sky would have to fall to the ground.
target: Uma Sonata pungente, que evoca tristeza, pertencente aos solitários enlutados. Quando o chamado nunca é atendido, até mesmo as asas que uma vez voaram pelo céu teriam que cair ao chão.

source: A seemingly calm but powerful Sonata that belongs to the powerful who can manipulate the thunder. Storms do not issue a warning, but no one can ignore their omen.
target: Uma Sonata aparentemente calma, mas poderosa, que pertence aos poderosos que podem manipular o trovão. As tempestades não emitem um aviso, mas ninguém pode ignorar seu presságio.

source: Eine Sonate aus einem verlorenen Zeitalter, die dem ungekrönten König gehört. Einige Stimmen scheinen vergessen zu sein, aber ihr Erwachen erfordert oft nur einen kurzen Abschnitt einer vertrauten Melodie.
target: Uma Sonata de uma era perdida que pertence ao rei sem coroa. Algumas vozes parecem ser esquecidas, mas seu despertar muitas vezes requer apenas um curto segmento de uma melodia familiar.

source: Eine Sonate mit einer einfachen, harmonischen Melodie. Für den Rover, der auf der Reise zurück ist, ist es am angemessensten, den Rhythmus des Kampfes anzupassen.
target:
Uma Sonata para o Rover
que retorna, sua melodia harmoniosa para guiar e estabilizar seu ritmo de batalha na jornada.

source: Eine ergreifende, Trauer hervorrufende Sonate, die den einsamen Trauernden gehört. Wenn der Ruf nie beantwortet wird, müssen selbst die Flügel, die einst den Himmel durchquerten, auf den Boden fallen.
target: Uma Sonata pungente, que evoca tristeza, pertencente aos solitários enlutados. Quando o chamado nunca é atendido, até mesmo as asas que uma vez voaram pelo céu teriam que cair ao chão.

source: Eine laute, wilde, aber lebendige Sonate, die dem immer blühenden Leben gehört. Diejenigen, die behaupten, außergewöhnlich zu sein, zeigen oft wenig Geduld, um dem Ruf der Wildnis zu lauschen, bis diese Stimme nahe an ihrem Ohr ist.
target: Uma Sonata barulhenta, selvagem, mas vibrante que pertence às vidas sempre florescentes. Aqueles que se dizem extraordinários muitas vezes mostram pouca paciência para ouvir o chamado da natureza, até que essa voz esteja próxima ao seu ouvido.

source: Eine lebhafte und intensive Sonate, die den Kriegern gehört, die das Schlachtfeld erobern können. Die brennende Flamme ist der Takt des Marsches, die triumphierenden Schritte auf der Flamme mit brennenden Überzeugungen.
target: Uma Sonata animada e intensa que pertence aos guerreiros que podem conquistar o campo de batalha. A chama ardente é o ritmo da marcha, os passos triunfantes sobre a chama com convicções ardentes.

source: Eine scheinbar ruhige, aber mächtige Sonate, die den Mächtigen gehört, die den Donner manipulieren können. Stürme geben keine Warnung, aber niemand kann ihr Omen ignorieren.
target: Uma Sonata aparentemente calma, mas poderosa, que pertence aos poderosos que podem manipular o trovão. As tempestades não emitem um aviso, mas ninguém pode ignorar seu presságio.

source: Eine schwer fassbare, flüchtige Sonate, die den in den Frostnebeln Verlorenen gehört. Die illusorischen Traumländer sind viel kälter als die Realität. Eine unachtsame Berührung kann einen in einen nie endenden Traum fangen.
target: Uma Sonata elusiva e tênue que pertence àqueles perdidos na névoa gelada. As terras de sonho ilusórias são muito mais frias do que a realidade. Um toque descuidado pode prender alguém em um sonho do qual nunca acordará.

target: Sempre que um membro do grupo lança Liberação de Ressonância, o pilar liberará uma onda de choque adicional enquanto existir.

source: โซนาตาที่ดูสงบนิ่งแต่ซ่อนพลังอันยิ่งใหญ่ไว้ภายใน เป็นของผู้แข็งแกร่งที่สามารถควบคุมสายฟ้าได้อย่างแท้จริง พายุไม่เคยส่งสัญญาณเตือนล่วงหน้า แต่ไม่มีใครสามารถเพิกเฉยต่อเค้าลางของมันได้
target: Uma Sonata aparentemente calma, mas poderosa, que pertence aos poderosos que podem manipular o trovão. As tempestades não emitem um aviso, mas ninguém pode ignorar seu presságio.

source: โซนาตาที่ป่าเถื่อนและดุดัน เป็นของชีวิตที่คงอยู่และสืบต่อไม่รู้จบ ผู้ที่หลงคิดว่าตนสูงส่งมักไร้ความอดทนต่อเสียงจากผืนป่า จนกว่าจะรู้ตัวว่าเสียงนั้นอยู่ใกล้เพียงปลายหู
target: Uma Sonata barulhenta, selvagem, mas vibrante que pertence às vidas sempre florescentes. Aqueles que se dizem extraordinários muitas vezes mostram pouca paciência para ouvir o chamado da natureza, até que essa voz esteja próxima ao seu ouvido.

source: โซนาตาที่เรียบง่ายแต่สวย สำหรับผู้พเนจรที่เริ่มต้นการเดินทางอีกครั้ง มันเหมาะที่สุดในการปรับสมดุลของการต่อสู้
target:
Uma Sonata para o Rover
que retorna, sua melodia harmoniosa para guiar e estabilizar seu ritmo de batalha na jornada.

source: โซนาตาที่เลือนรางและจับต้องไม่ได้ เป็นของผู้หลงทางท่ามกลางหมอกเยือกแข็ง ภาพลวงตานั้นเย็นยะเยือกกว่าความจริงหลายเท่า การเอื้อมมือแตะเพียงเบาๆ อาจหมายถึงการจมอยู่ในฝันนิรันดร์
target: Uma Sonata elusiva e tênue que pertence àqueles perdidos na névoa gelada. As terras de sonho ilusórias são muito mais frias do que a realidade. Um toque descuidado pode prender alguém em um sonho do qual nunca acordará.

source: โซนาตาอันเร่าร้อนและเปี่ยมพลัง เป็นของนักรบที่สามารถพิชิตสนามต่อสู้ได้อย่างแท้จริง เปลวไฟที่ลุกโชนคือจังหวะกลองแห่งการรุกคืบ ผู้ชนะย่ำเดินบนเพลิงไฟด้วยหัวใจที่ลุกไหม้ไปด้วยไฟแห่งการต่อสู้
target: Uma Sonata animada e intensa que pertence aos guerreiros que podem conquistar o campo de batalha. A chama ardente é o ritmo da marcha, os passos triunfantes sobre a chama com convicções ardentes.

source: โซนาตาแห่งความโศกเศร้า เป็นของผู้โดดเดี่ยวที่สูญเสียคู่ครอง เมื่อเสียงเรียกหามิได้รับการตอบสนอง ปีกที่เคยโบยบินบนท้องฟ้าก็ร่วงหล่นสู่พื้นดิน
target: Uma Sonata pungente, que evoca tristeza, pertencente aos solitários enlutados. Quando o chamado nunca é atendido, até mesmo as asas que uma vez voaram pelo céu teriam que cair ao chão.
